name: Presenter panel (quiet button)
definition: Low-visibility button that opens presenter-only notes, ready for Q&A or any point in the talk.
bestUse: Keeping prompts for Q&A available without showing them to the audience.

demo.how: A faint button sits in the corner of the slide. Activating it opens a small panel of presenter prompts; it stays visually quiet so the audience barely notices it. Reset hides the panel again.
